stepNotes.1: The directory combines agent state/policy/events with workspace CRUD, adaptor proxying, SSE sync, and a loopback workspace server.
stepNotes.2: Threats span premature completion and unsafe actions plus adaptor SSRF, credential forwarding, oversized SSE, retry storms, and cleanup failure.
stepNotes.3: Explicit transitions and completion assertions fail closed; proxy paths/headers are sanitized, cleanup preserves rows on failure, and reconnect is abort-aware.
stepNotes.4: SSE messages, subscriber queues, forwarded headers, and retry delay all have explicit bounds; policy scans remain turn-sized linear work.
stepNotes.5: Agent and workspace subdomains are internally cohesive, but ExecutionController and workspace router/context currently have only test call sites.
stepNotes.6: No TODOs or empty catches exist; dormant integration surfaces and test-only adaptor installation are the specific hygiene concerns.
stepNotes.7: Direct policy and transport tests are broad; a production wiring test for controller/router installation is the central missing proof.
stepNotes.8: No finding was accepted because the observed issue is inactive wiring rather than a violated active runtime invariant.
stepNotes.9: The selected audit/control-plane run passed 104 tests and core typechecking passed.
